name: mcp-imslp
description: MCP server for IMSLP, the Petrucci Music Library. Read works, scores and recordings. No API key required.
long_description: Search the works and the people of IMSLP, read a work with its facets in the wording its page used, page through the editions it holds with their publishers, editors and copyright status per jurisdiction, and browse a genre, a key or an instrumentation. No API key, no account, read-only, and no score file is ever downloaded.

tools.name: search_works
tools.description: Search the works of IMSLP by title, by composer, or by words printed on their pages.

query.description: What to look for in the works of the library. Words are matched across the page, not only titles.

offset.description: Rows to skip, using the 'next_offset' a previous answer named.

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Find the composers, editors, arrangers and performers of IMSLP by name.

query.description: What to look for among the people of the library. Words are matched across the page, not only titles.

offset.description: Rows to skip, using the 'next_offset' a previous answer named.

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: Read one work: its titles, composer, catalogue numbers, dates, key, instrumentation and the terms its scores are published under.

page.description: The title of the work's page, written 'Work (Composer)', for example 'Nocturnes, Op.9 (Chopin, Frédéric)'. Pass this or 'pageid', not both.

pageid.description: The page id a search returns. Pass this or 'page', not both.

tools.name: list_work_files
tools.description: Read the scores and recordings a work holds, edition by edition, with the copyright status of each.

page.description: The title of the work's page, written 'Work (Composer)', for example 'Nocturnes, Op.9 (Chopin, Frédéric)'. Pass this or 'pageid', not both.

pageid.description: The page id a search returns. Pass this or 'page', not both.

section.description: One section of the page, in the wording the page prints: 'Scores', 'Parts', 'Recordings', 'Arrangements and Transcriptions', 'Full Scores', 'Synthesized/MIDI'. Matched without regard to case. Left out, every section is read.

offset.description: Editions to skip, for reading a work whose page holds many.

tools.name: list_person_works
tools.description: Read the works IMSLP files under a person, as a composer, an editor, an arranger or a performer.

category.description: The person's category, written 'Category:Surname, Forename', for example 'Category:Chopin, Frédéric'. The prefix is added when it is left out.

cursor.description: The 'cursor' a previous answer named, to read on from where it stopped. The library writes it itself, so it is passed back as it was given rather than built.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Read what IMSLP holds about a person: the name its page prints, the life dates it states, and the registers holding a record of them.

category.description: The person's category, written 'Category:Surname, Forename', for example 'Category:Satie, Erik'. The prefix is added when it is left out.

tools.name: browse_category
tools.description: Read the works IMSLP files under a genre, a key, an instrumentation or a period.

category.description: The category to read, in the library's own wording, for example 'For piano', 'Nocturnes' or 'Category:B-flat minor'. The prefix is added when it is left out.

cursor.description: The 'cursor' a previous answer named, to read on from where it stopped. The library writes it itself, so it is passed back as it was given rather than built.
